title: Kusanagi Nene — Into A Magical Dress〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, here it is.
The collector's edition of Agent Ignition 2...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oof... That's a hefty price tag...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I want the artbook, reference guide and soundtrack... And this edition has the best weapon skins, too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay to buy something like this every once in a while. I mean, I have been working pretty hard lately...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My reservation's in...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll have to cut back on spending for a couple months, but it's all for a good cause...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm? An update on recommended items?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. I set things up so that I'd receive a notification when that best-of for the Fernbay troupe went on sale again after seeing that rumor on social media.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's been three months since that rumor started going around. At this point, I doubt they'll rerun it at all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, I have to hold off on making any more purchases until next month. I'll take a quick look and turn off that notification...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've already taken a look at these new games and sequels. I'll come back to them after I've had a chance to read some of the reviews...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Games, games, movie Blu-ray, more games, Fernbay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh...?
W-Wait a second...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “The Best of Fernbay”...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why is it coming back now?!
The next day
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...is what happened yesterday.
*Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Didn't you say a little while back that you'd absolutely buy this troupe's Blu-ray set if it ever went back on sale?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uhh... What were they called? Burn bay...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's Fernbay.
They only do small shows since they're not a big troupe, but their original scripts are always phenomenal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My favorite ones are a part of this collection, but the last time it was on sale I was still in junior high. Then, before I knew it, they completely sold out...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, why is it coming back now?!
I have to cut back for the next two months already after buying Agent Ignition 2.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means you haven't been able to buy that set...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Have you already asked your mom about this?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She said she'd be willing to buy it for me, since it'd help me learn more about doing shows...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel bad about having to ask her just because I'm also buying a game...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, Tsukasa, you've been working as an extra from time to time. Is it possible to go for just one day?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you can apply for those whenever they're available.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, there's sometimes an interview involved, since they need their cast members to fulfill certain requirements.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In other words, it's not guaranteed I'd be able to work immediately after applying...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're still in the middle of training with another troupe, so I was hoping to grab a quick job on one of our days off or something...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, you may want to expand your search to include other short-term jobs that don't necessarily involve being an extra.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Would you really prefer to work on a show, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I mean...
That's what I'm used to doing, and I'm more or less confident in my abilities...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, then lemme try asking!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Shosuke? Sorry, I know you're still at work. Do you have a second to talk?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Remember how you said you were looking for people to work as event staff? Right... Uh-huh... Yeah, I think I've got someone for you♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll ask her now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting☆
They're still looking for people to work on their show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, but I clearly heard you say, “Event staff,” just now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, so the Phoenix Bridal Fair is happening again really soon!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Why does that sound so familiar...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki and a few others went to it a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I do remember hearing something about a show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You heard correctly♪ My brothers told me that they were still looking for cast members. So, Nene, how does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Pretty good...
So, Emu, can you tell me a little more?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure☆
